versions.changelog:
- Added a sample output screenshot to the documentation (assets/briefing-screenshot.jpg)
- Updated SKILL.md to include and display the new screenshot example for easier understanding of the briefing output

No user-visible code changes; documentation updates only.

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify example output format for trend lines.
- Improved and simplified instructions for adding OpenClaw cron jobs.
- Replaced manual JSON job sample with CLI-based cron job creation example.
- Added environment variable `{workspace}` hints for improved usability.

Initial release of daum-trends-briefing.

- Fetches Daum 실시간 트렌드 TOP10 and extracts one representative news title and link per keyword.
- Outputs a formatted 12-line briefing suitable for OpenClaw cron jobs and Telegram announcements.
- Uses minimal parsing of Daum's HTML/JSON to extract trend data efficiently.
- Provides clear setup instructions for local runs and OpenClaw integration.
